description: Official data contract for Layer 1 multi-horizon zone-level taxi ride demand forecasting. Consumable by Layer 3 fleet supply estimation.

zone_id.description: NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission official Taxi Zone ID (PULocationID).
zone_id.title: Zone Id

forecast_origin.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) representing when the forecast was generated.
forecast_origin.title: Forecast Origin

target_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing the start of the 1-hour interval being predicted.
target_timestamp.title: Target Timestamp

horizon_minutes.description: Lead time in minutes from forecast_origin to target_timestamp (e.g. 60, 180, 360).
horizon_minutes.title: Horizon Minutes

predicted_rides.description: Predicted passenger ride demand (expected completed pickups) during the target hour.
predicted_rides.title: Predicted Rides

lower_bound.description: Calibrated lower prediction bound (e.g. 80% confidence). Clamped at 0.0.
lower_bound.title: Lower Bound

upper_bound.description: Calibrated upper prediction bound (e.g. 80% confidence). >= lower_bound.
upper_bound.title: Upper Bound

model_version.description: Identifier of the forecasting model generating this prediction.
model_version.title: Model Version

title: Layer1DemandForecastRecord
